battle.name: 安哥拉內戰
battle.brief: 安哥拉內戰自1975年獨立前後爆發，安哥拉人民解放運動MPLA、右翼全國解放陣線UNITA與民族解放陣線FNLA為爭取國家政權而交戰。這場內戰與非洲冷戰代理人戰高度重疊，MPLA曾獲得的蘇制裝備包括1974年列裝的AK-74突擊步槍。

kit.name: 卡拉什尼科夫突擊步槍
kit.history: AK-74是蘇軍摩托化步兵師步兵連的制式突擊步槍，配置於基層步兵班，負責近距離一般火力，是連隊地面進攻中的主要步兵武器。

countries: 1975年的安哥拉並非單一政府與叛軍交火，而是葡萄牙殖民政府迅速退場後，三支獨立組織共同爭奪國家權力的斷裂局面。MPLA以北部、東部林區與城市聯絡網為根基，11月11日宣告成立安哥拉人民共和國；FNLA依托剛果民主共和國（時稱薩伊）的邊境後勤，沿北部通道向羅安達與洛比托一帶施壓；UNITA則由尚比亞進入庫安戈班古、Bié及Huambo高原，保有長距離機動空間。葡萄牙在1月底撤出羅安達，卻留下武器、營區和分散據點。古巴與蘇聯支持MPLA，美國及薩伊支持FNLA，中國主要經尚比亞援助UNITA，南非更以Savannah行動直接進入南部戰線。
countriesEn: Angola in 1975 was not a single government fighting an insurgency; it was a fragmented struggle for state power that began as Portugal's colonial government withdrew rapidly. The MPLA was rooted in contact networks across the northern and eastern forest zones and cities, and it declared the People's Republic of Angola on 11 November. The FNLA relied on border logistics in what was then Zaire, now the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and pressed down northern routes toward Luanda and Lobito. UNITA entered Cuando Cubango, Bié, and the Huambo highlands from Zambia, preserving long-range mobility. Portugal withdrew from Luanda by the end of January but left weapons, barracks, and dispersed posts behind. Cuba and the Soviet Union supported the MPLA; the United States and Zaire supported the FNLA; China aided UNITA mainly through Zambia; and South Africa entered the southern front directly under Operation Savannah.
people: 1975年的指揮問題，必須同時寫入三組織最高領袖與前線指揮。主持MPLA的阿戈什蒂紐·內圖把政治領導、軍隊整編與羅安達控制集中在中央；FNLA領袖霍爾登·羅伯托常駐剛果，跨越邊界調度資源，容易令前線與本部脫節；UNITA領袖喬納斯·薩文比則把中部高原作為作戰主體，以流動游擊對抗占據主要城市的MPLA。FNLA北部指揮官丹尼爾·奇佩恩達在1975年3月脫離該組織並率部加入MPLA，北線因此出現成建制轉投。葡方總理馬里奧·索雷斯與外長維托里諾·戈爾什維斯參與1月15日Alvor談判，但協議無法確保三支武裝共享指揮、糧餉和武器。菲德爾·卡斯楚在內圖請求後決定部署Carlota；首批古巴部隊先守住羅安達並打通中南部走廊，並非立即替MPLA控制全部國土。
peopleEn: Command during 1975 cannot be explained solely through the three top leaders; front-line commanders were equally important. Agostinho Neto, who headed the MPLA, centralized political leadership, military integration, and control of Luanda. FNLA leader Holden Roberto was often based in Congo and directed resources across the border, which could weaken the connection between the headquarters and forward commands. UNITA leader Jonas Savimbi made the central highlands the main theatre of operations, using mobile guerrilla warfare against an MPLA that occupied the principal cities. Daniel Chipenda, a senior FNLA commander in the north, left the organization with his troops in March 1975 and joined the MPLA, producing an organized transfer across the northern front. Portuguese prime minister Mário Soares and foreign minister Vítorino Gonçalves participated in the Alvor talks on 15 January, but the agreement could not ensure shared command, pay, and weapons among the three armed formations. Fidel Castro decided to deploy Operation Carlota after Neto's request. The initial Cuban mission was to hold Luanda and open a central-southern corridor, not to impose immediate MPLA control over the entire country.
kits: 1975年的作戰裝備橫跨葡萄牙、美國、中國、古巴與蘇聯供應鏈，不能用同一套武器描述三方。葡軍撤走後，HK G3步槍、FN FAL步槍、勃朗寧High Power手槍、7.62×51毫米北約彈及12.7毫米重機槍彈留在前葡軍庫房；MPLA使用的AK-47、PKM、RPG-7、SKS與82毫米迫擊砲則主要依賴7.62×39毫米彈。美國援助FNLA的M1卡賓槍和FNLA-4四輪驅動車，在北線快速機動中相當醒目；UNITA則使用中國援助的56式步槍、四輪驅動車和迫擊砲。古巴援軍可見T-34/85坦克、PT-76輕型坦克、BRDM-1裝甲車及ZU-23-2雙聯高射砲；南非Savannah部隊投入Eland-7裝甲車、Saracen裝甲運兵車與Alvis 6×6卡車。這些型號在1975年以前均已列裝，.30-06與上述數種步槍彈藥的供應是否同步，反而直接影響長距離作戰。
kitsEn: The equipment employed in 1975 came through Portuguese, American, Chinese, Cuban, and Soviet supply chains, so the three Angolan movements cannot be described with a single common inventory. After the Portuguese departure, former Portuguese depots contained HK G3 rifles, FN FAL rifles, Browning High Power pistols, 7.62×51 mm NATO ammunition, and 12.7 mm machine-gun ammunition. MPLA forces used AK-47 rifles, PKM machine guns, RPG-7 launchers, SKS rifles, and 82 mm mortars, principally with 7.62×39 mm ammunition. American aid gave the FNLA M1 carbines and FNLA-4 four-wheel-drive trucks, which were conspicuous during rapid operations in the north. UNITA used Chinese-supplied Type 56 rifles, four-wheel-drive vehicles, and mortars. Cuban forces brought T-34/85 tanks, PT-76 light tanks, BRDM-1 armored vehicles, and ZU-23-2 twin anti-aircraft guns. South African forces under Savannah employed Eland-7 armored cars, Saracen armored personnel carriers, and Alvis 6×6 trucks. All these models had entered service by 1975, and the availability of .30-06 and the different rifle-ammunition types directly affected the reach of sustained operations.
tactics: 戰法在葡殖民階段與1975年明顯不同。1961至1974年，MPLA及其他民族主義武裝以小隊伏擊道路與鐵路、襲擊稅站和孤立哨所，葡軍則依靠公路網、堡壘、空中與砲火支援及集中部隊封鎖。Alvor失效後，FNLA企圖以薩伊運來的卡車和機動步兵沿北部公路逼近羅安達，再威脅洛比托至內陸的Benguela鐵路；UNITA避開正面攻城，以Huambo、Bié和庫安戈班古為基地，襲擊MPLA側翼與交通線。古巴部隊在羅安達港集中後，以坦克支援步兵，優先打通Luanda—Malanje—Huambo公路與Lobito—Catumbela—Cubal—Caluquembe鐵路周邊；南非部隊則由納米比亞邊境推進，以Calulo為支撐，朝Cuito Cuanavale方向建立南線縱深。無論卡車縱隊或裝甲車團，都受道路承重、燃料、輪胎、備件、無線電中繼與故障回收限制；砲兵彈藥若不能同車隊抵達，前線火力便會在補給間隙迅速耗盡。
tacticsEn: Tactics during the colonial phase differed markedly from those of 1975. From 1961 to 1974, the MPLA and other nationalist organizations used small ambush teams against roads and railways, attacked tax posts, and isolated Portuguese sentries. The Portuguese relied on road networks, fortified positions, air and artillery support, and concentrated troop deployments. After Alvor became ineffective, the FNLA attempted to use trucks and motorized infantry brought through Zaire to advance along northern roads toward Luanda and threaten the Benguela Railway between Lobito and the interior. UNITA avoided frontal assaults on major cities and used Huambo, Bié, and Cuando Cubango as bases from which to strike MPLA flanks and transport routes. Cuban forces concentrated at Luanda harbor and used their tanks to support infantry, prioritizing the Luanda–Malanje–Huambo road and the Lobito–Catumbela–Cubal–Caluquembe railway corridor. South African troops advanced from the Namibian border, used Calulo as a support point, and built depth toward Cuito Cuanavale. Truck columns and armored formations were constrained by road bearing, fuel, tires, spare parts, radio relay, and recovery requirements. If artillery ammunition did not move with the column, forward firepower could be exhausted during the interval between resupply.
data: 按日期核對，1961年2月4日北起義與羅安達監獄突擊拉開獨立戰爭；FNLA在1961年成立，UNITA在1966年成立，兩者與MPLA的分裂不是1975年才出現。1974年4月25日葡萄牙康乃馨革命後，里斯本接受撤出殖民戰爭。1975年1月15日簽署的Alvor Agreement原設計三支武裝各六千人、合共一萬八千人的統合部隊與政治過渡，但1月27日葡萄牙最後部隊撤出羅安達後，紙面統合很快瓦解。2至3月奇佩恩達脫離FNLA，北線出現整批轉投；4至8月，MPLA在Lunda Norte、Malanje及Lobito—Catumbela—Cubal—Caluquembe沿線反覆爭奪，FNLA由薩伊邊境施壓，UNITA從尚比亞進入內陸，兩組織有時協同、有時也爭奪據點。9至10月南非越過納米比亞邊境並展開Savannah；11月11日MPLA宣告建國，11月中旬首批古巴部隊抵達，11月19日Carlota正式展開。12月MPLA與古巴部隊鞏固羅安達並把FNLA逐離首都接近區；UNITA仍在內陸保持野戰力量，Alvor所訂選舉未舉行。
dataEn: The chronology begins on 4 February 1961, when the northern uprising and the attack on the Luanda prison opened the independence war. The FNLA was formed in 1961 and UNITA in 1966, so the divisions with the MPLA did not first appear in 1975. After Portugal's Carnation Revolution on 25 April 1974, Lisbon accepted an end to the colonial war. The Alvor Agreement, signed on 15 January 1975, envisioned an integrated force of 6,000 men from each movement, for a total of 18,000, together with a political transition. After the last Portuguese troops left Luanda on 27 January, however, the paper integration rapidly broke down. Chipenda left the FNLA between February and March, taking an organized body of troops with him. From April through August, the MPLA repeatedly contested Lunda Norte, Malanje, and the Lobito–Catumbela–Cubal–Caluquembe corridor, while the FNLA pressed from the Zaire frontier and UNITA entered the interior from Zambia. The FNLA and UNITA sometimes coordinated but also competed for positions. South African forces crossed the Namibian border and expanded Operation Savannah between September and October. The MPLA declared independence on 11 November; the first Cuban troops arrived in mid-November; and Carlota formally began on 19 November. During December, MPLA and Cuban forces consolidated Luanda and drove the FNLA away from the approaches to the capital. UNITA retained field forces in the interior, and the elections prescribed by Alvor were never held.
cause: 1975年內戰的直接起點，是葡萄牙在殖民戰爭尚未結束時突然失去戰鬥意願，政治權力卻沒有交到任何單一安哥拉組織手中。Alvor把選舉、軍隊整編、總統過渡與葡軍撤退寫在同一框架內，卻低估三方彼此的不信任：MPLA要求中央國家機關，FNLA要求北部影響力與軍事配給，UNITA拒絕把游擊隊伍交給一個自己不控制的統合司令部。紙面一萬八千人的規模也無法消化各地既有武裝與據點。外部援助早於葡萄牙退場便已存在；撤軍後，美國、薩伊、古巴、蘇聯、中國與南非分別強化各自支持的陣線，使原本可由葡軍集中反制的戰線變成長期代理衝突。道路、海港與Benguela鐵路決定部隊能否持續作戰，因此控制補給軸線與占據城市同樣成為爭奪中心。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the 1975 civil war was Portugal's sudden loss of willingness to continue the colonial war while political authority was transferred to none of the Angolan organizations. Alvor placed elections, military integration, a presidential transition, and Portuguese withdrawal within a single framework, but it underestimated the distrust among the three parties. The MPLA sought control of the central state institutions; the FNLA demanded influence and military allocations in the north; UNITA refused to place its guerrilla forces under an integrated command it would not control. The planned force of 18,000 men could not absorb the established formations and positions already held in different regions. Foreign assistance existed before Portugal withdrew, but afterward support from the United States, Zaire, Cuba, the Soviet Union, China, and South Africa reinforced separate aligned forces. Fronts that Portugal could previously contain with concentrated counterinsurgency forces became a prolonged proxy conflict. Roads, ports, and the Benguela Railway determined whether troops could remain supplied, making control of transport corridors as important as control of cities.
impact: 1975年最重要的結構性影響，是MPLA從一個戰區力量變成掌握國家首都、行政機構與外交身分的一方。羅安達一旦失守，MPLA的北部補給與外部援助管道便會同時中斷；保住羅安達及Lobito鐵路關鍵段，則讓MPLA能持續把外來武器轉成前沿戰力。古巴以Carlota直接出兵，南非以Savannah直接出兵，使安哥拉不再只是三個本地組織的競爭，而成為古巴、蘇聯、美國、南非、薩伊及尚比亞政策交錯的戰場。這種介入也把1975年的兵運推到機械化階段：裝甲車需要長距離公路縱隊，步兵需要集中火力與定點補給，後勤線一旦遭切斷，進攻速度便迅速下降。外交承認、港口使用與軍事物資流向從此高度連動，促使之後數年的內戰維持高強度，而1975年形成的對外連結並未因任何一次進攻而消失。
impactEn: The most important structural consequence of 1975 was the MPLA's transformation from a regional movement into the force controlling the national capital, administrative institutions, and diplomatic identity. Losing Luanda would have cut both MPLA northern supply routes and its external aid channels. Holding Luanda and critical sections of the Lobito railway allowed the MPLA to convert foreign weapons into combat power at the front. Cuba entered directly through Carlota, while South Africa entered through Savannah. Angola was therefore no longer a contest confined to three local organizations; it became a theatre where Cuban, Soviet, American, South African, Zairian, and Zambian policies intersected. This intervention also pushed 1975 logistics toward a mechanized scale. Armored formations required long road columns, infantry required concentrated firepower and fixed supply points, and an interrupted logistics route could rapidly reduce the speed of advance. Diplomatic recognition, access to ports, and weapons flows became closely connected, helping sustain the high intensity of the conflict in subsequent years. The external links established in 1975 did not disappear after any single offensive.
result: 就1975年度戰役而言，葡萄牙在羅安達的實際殖民控制已告終結，MPLA保住首都、國家機關與沿海若干關鍵補給點，並以11月11日建國宣言取得國家代表性。FNLA在北線的攻勢受挫，被迫退向北部及邊緣地帶；UNITA沒有被消滅，仍在中部與南部內陸維持成建制力量。古巴Carlota與南非Savannah也從緊急或有限介入，轉為長期軍事存在的開端。因此，1975的勝負不是整場內戰的和平終點：MPLA取得的是執政與持續作戰能力，FNLA和UNITA仍有再戰餘力。整場安哥拉內戰直到2002年4月4日Luena備忘錄達成政治與軍事安排，才進入最終終局。
resultEn: For the 1975 campaign, Portugal's effective colonial control of Luanda had ended. The MPLA retained the capital, the state institutions, and several critical coastal supply points, and its declaration on 11 November gave it national representation. The FNLA's northern offensive was checked and its forces withdrew toward peripheral and northern areas. UNITA was not eliminated and continued to maintain organized forces in the central and southern interior. Cuban Operation Carlota and South African Operation Savannah also developed from urgent or limited interventions into the beginning of lasting military involvement. The outcome of 1975 was therefore not a peaceful conclusion to the entire civil war. The MPLA gained the ability to govern and continue fighting, while the FNLA and UNITA retained the capacity to resume operations. The full Angolan Civil War reached its final settlement only on 4 April 2002, when the Luena Memorandum established a political and military arrangement.
